claims.content: The Auctioneer wants to maintain auction event profiles by accessing and editing them via the 'Edit Auction Event Profiles' option in the Administration Menu of the Auction Admin Main Menu.
The Auctioneer accesses the Manage Auction Event Profiles page from the Auction Admin Main Menu, and the system displays that page connected directly to the Auction Admin Main Menu Page.
The Auctioneer chooses an existing Auction Event Profile from the list on the page.
The Auctioneer clicks the profile name so the page is populated with previously entered values.
The Auctioneer fills in the upper range of the cost tier, and the system automatically fills in the lower range of the subsequent cost tier by adding $0.01 to the last value entered.
The Auctioneer designates an auction duration for all items within the cost tier.
The Auctioneer clicks Apply to save changes to the Auction Event Profile.
The Auctioneer searches for and selects a list of auction products.
Once the auction group has been created, the Auctioneer chooses to apply an event profile to the group rather than creating the auction manually.
The Auctioneer selects one of the available event profiles from a list box displayed under the search results.
The Auctioneer clicks Apply to apply the selected event profile to all previously selected items.
The system applies the selected event profile to all previously selected items.
The system provides feedback via highlighted rows and status indicators (such as checked boxes next to selected items) confirming the application of settings.

claims.content: The Auctioneer wants to maintain Auction Event Profiles that provide a common set of characteristics to groups of products.
The Auctioneer is logged into the system and has access to the Auction Administration Application.
The Auctioneer wants to maintain auction event profiles by accessing and editing them via the 'Edit Auction Event Profiles' option in the Administration Menu of the Auction Admin Main Menu.
The Auctioneer accesses the Manage Auction Event Profiles page from the Auction Admin Main Menu, and the system displays that page connected directly to the Auction Admin Main Menu Page.
The Auctioneer chooses an existing Auction Event Profile from the list on the page.
The Auctioneer clicks the profile name so the page is populated with previously entered values.
The Auctioneer fills in the upper range of the cost tier, and the system automatically fills in the lower range of the subsequent cost tier by adding $0.01 to the last value entered.
The Auctioneer designates an auction duration for all items within the cost tier.
The Auctioneer clicks Apply to save changes to the Auction Event Profile.
The Auctioneer searches for and selects a list of auction products.
Once the auction group has been created, the Auctioneer chooses to apply an event profile to the group rather than creating the auction manually.
The Auctioneer selects one of the available event profiles from a list box displayed under the search results.
The Auctioneer clicks Apply to apply the selected event profile to all previously selected items.
The system applies the selected event profile to all previously selected items.
The system provides feedback via highlighted rows and status indicators (such as checked boxes next to selected items) confirming the application of settings.

Diverges from step 2: if the Auctioneer wants to create a new promotional event profile rather than choose an existing Auction Event Profile to maintain, the Auctioneer tabs or clicks into the 'Create New Profile' field, enters a new profile name, and clicks 'Create'. The Auctioneer then fills in the cost tier upper ranges; the system automatically fills in the lower range of the subsequent cost tier by adding $0.01 to the last value entered until all fields are completed. The Auctioneer chooses radio buttons for the opening bid basis ('amount' or '% of cost'), designates bid increments and auction durations per tier, selects applicability via radio buttons at the bottom, and clicks 'Apply' to finish profile creation.

If the Auctioneer selects an Auction Event Profile restricted to a specific product category (for example, 'Apply to Gemstones Only') and attempts to apply it to an incompatible grouping of items (for example, jewelry items), the system generates an error message stating that the profile can only be applied to products in the specified category.
The Auction Event Profile has been created or edited and saved to the system with its entered characteristics, including cost tiers, opening bids, bid increments, durations, and applicability rules.
The selected Auction Event Profile has been applied to all previously selected items.
